reference.capture: Local Chrome SVG image/background rendering; all page requests blocked; static data URLs only.
reference.autoSizingNote: img naturalWidth/naturalHeight are recorded separately; ratio-only SVG backgrounds use the positioning-area contain constraint, SVGs with no intrinsic dimensions or ratio use the positioning area as their concrete size, and SVGs with one intrinsic axis but no ratio use the positioning area for the missing auto axis. autoTileSizeFromRenderedColorBoundaries is derived from screenshot transitions.
